data.name: Beaver Arena
data.detailed_description:
Beaver Arena is a fast-paced arena rogue-lite shooter with bullet-heaven mechanics. You take control of a glowing cyber-sphere and step into a closed neon arena to survive against endless waves of hostile geometry.

Your primary goal is to stay alive until the timer runs out. Enemies close in from all directions, leaving you with less room to breathe every second. Master the precise timing of your Dash to slip through tight crowds and unleash devastating area-of-effect attacks.

Every destroyed shape drops data fragments (XP). Collect them to level up mid-run and build your ultimate loadout. With each level up, you choose from randomized tactical modules: homing plasma bolts, orbital shields, gravity fields, or chain detonators. No two runs are ever the same.

Each phase culminates in a tense boss fight against a massive crystalline Overlord that will test your reflexes and positioning. Earn currency across your runs to permanently upgrade your sphere's base stats in the main menu and return to the arena as an unstoppable force.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo or AMD Athlon 64 X2
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
